title: Departure Date Read From a Turned-Away Health-Care Absence Notice — Occupancy and Residency Certification
content:
For a health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, the **departure date** is read from the turned-away notice — the rejected health-care absence notice about the monitored borrower received most recently, with the admission date it states, the date it was received and its reject reason:

| Turned-away notice | Departure date |
|---|---|
| states an admission earlier than the facility admission date and was rejected only because of who sent it (reject reason: signer not required) | the admission date the turned-away notice states |
| states such an earlier admission and was rejected for any other reason | the earlier of the date the turned-away notice was received and the facility admission date |
| any other case — no turned-away notice, or one stating an admission on or after the facility admission date | the facility admission date |

The facility admission date is the date stated on the accepted health-care absence notice about the monitored borrower received most recently.

## Points of judgement

- A notice turned away only for its sender still evidences the admission it states, so that admission date is the departure date.
- A notice turned away for any other reason contributes only its receipt date, and never a date later than the facility admission date.
- *Hypothetical case.* A turned-away notice states an admission three weeks before the accepted admission date, was rejected for a reason other than its sender, and was received ten days before the accepted admission date: the departure date is its receipt date, the earlier of the two dates.
